verdict.rationale: Beamer documents collecting feedback, including comments, reactions, NPS surveys and prioritized feedback. Separately it offers segmentation by user attributes and a HubSpot sync. None of the evidence says individual feedback items are attributed to or linked with the specific customers who submitted them. Those related features are adjacent and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a product-manager, I can link individual feedback items to the specific customers who submitted them
